purpose: Define one label-blind, geometry-only episode boundary for the public LiGaMD pKoff toolkit. It does not estimate physical koff and does not select a sampler, representation, or model.

episode_policy.confirmation_tail: read only to establish persistence; excluded from frame selection and model input
episode_policy.post_exit_diffusion: excluded from frame selection and model input

frame_conditions_all_required.name: pocket_aligned_ligand_centroid_displacement
frame_conditions_all_required.definition: geometric displacement of the ligand centroid after proper Kabsch alignment of frozen pocket heavy atoms to the canonical bound reference

frame_conditions_all_required.name: whole_protein_heavy_atom_clearance
frame_conditions_all_required.definition: minimum PBC-aware distance between any ligand heavy atom and any heavy atom in the standard-amino-acid protein universe

persistence.saved_frame_identity: dense trace frame column must be exactly 1..N without gaps
persistence.cadence: taken from the input manifest; the numerical contract counts saved frames and does not infer unsaved physical time

shared_reference.canonical_bound_structure: outcome-blind PDB supplied by the manifest
shared_reference.ligand_selector: one resolved ligand residue with frozen heavy-atom order
shared_reference.protein_atom_universe: ATOM records belonging to standard amino acids, heavy atoms only
shared_reference.pocket_residues: canonical-PDB residues whose PBC-aware minimum heavy-atom distance to the ligand is <= 8.0 A
shared_reference.native_contacts: subset of frozen pocket residues at <= 4.5 A in the canonical bound reference
shared_reference.periodic_boundary_conditions: orthorhombic minimum image: delta - box_length * rint(delta / box_length); non-orthorhombic cells fail closed

compatibility.sampler: P512_multiblock_path_arclength with 512 unique real source frames; sampler protocol is frozen separately
compatibility.trajectory_replication: exactly three endpoint-PASS replicas, pooled by arithmetic mean

endpoint_is_not: proof that interaction energy is zero
a claim that all possible solvent-mediated interactions vanish
